_comment: Negative fixture: the include chain is present (the /etc/passwd gate passes) but session.upload_progress.cleanup=On removed the session file before the readback — the readback include yields a 'Failed to open stream' warning with no command output, so command_output_readback.v1 stays NoMatch ('not exploitable as configured here'). Order matches the positive: the control (sess_missing) is listed before the readback (sess_ggsec...).
